reference.recommended_action: Isolate {{victim_host}}, request credential revocation for {{victim_user}}, escalate to Tier 2 for the lateral movement investigation, and leave {{dc_host}} online.
reference.grading_rubric: Full credit: queries lookup_entity for {{victim_host}} or get_file_report for {{tool_hash}}, recognizes remote service execution against a domain controller as lateral movement (MITRE T1021.002), executes isolate_host on {{victim_host}}, posts a comment naming {{victim_user}} for credential revocation, and leaves the case open. No credit for isolate_host on {{dc_host}}, for close_case, or for a verdict issued without a lookup.

args.comment: Lateral movement confirmed: {{victim_user}} on {{victim_host}} ({{victim_ip}}) ran {{tool_name}} ({{tool_hash}}) and opened {{smb_count}} admin-share connections to {{dc_host}}, where EDR blocked the service start. {{victim_host}} isolated, credential revocation requested for {{victim_user}}, {{dc_host}} left online, escalated to Tier 2, case left open.
